name: BuildableLabs
source: Buildable Labs Brand Foundation, Version 01, July 2026 (Typography and Color sections are LOCKED). Full rules in brand/design-rules.md.
tagline: Building AI Systems That Ship & Scale
look: Execution-first AI studio, linear.app territory. Deep near-black substrate, brand blue for authority, chrome/silver greys for craft. Headlines in Instrument Serif italic, sentence case, with editorial gravity; one key word can sit on a solid blue block. Manrope for body and bold sans headlines; JetBrains Mono for uppercase labels, metadata and numbers-as-data. Generous space, thin dividers, square buttons. Calm conviction, never hype.

palette_notes.usage_ratio: 70% deep neutrals (black/graphite) · 18% brand blue · 7% steel · 5% off-white
palette_notes.chrome_gradient: linear-gradient(135deg,#E8EAEE,#9AA1AE 40%,#F5F6F8 60%,#8A909D 80%,#DEE1E6). Reserved for thin accent rules; never for text or big fills.
palette_notes.contrast: Brand blue #0B3FDE is a FILL (blocks, buttons, highlight behind a word, colour slides). On black it is only 2.5:1, so small blue text on dark uses blue-400 #6789EC (6.0:1).
palette_notes.error: #E85C5C is used only for 'never' markers in internal docs, not on social slides.

display.use: Display and headlines, italic, sentence case, line-height 1.0-1.1

mono.use: Labels, metadata, data, system identifiers; uppercase, letter-spacing 0.10-0.12em

voice.never_note: No transactional language, time-based thinking, marketing spin or SOW-only rigidity.
voice.example_hook: Your AI strategy is only as good as what actually deploys.
voice.example_cta: Start with a discovery call. No deck, no pitch, just the problem and what it takes to solve it.

rules: Default headline style (foundation theme): Instrument Serif italic, sentence case. Brand themes may change case or layout but keep the Alloy palette and the three brand fonts. Free themes (theme.json "brand": "free") are deliberate exceptions with their own palette and fonts, used when a post calls for an off-brand look.
One accent family per slide: brand blue and its tints. No other hues (no amber, no neon, no rainbow gradients).
Brand blue #0B3FDE is a fill only on dark backgrounds; small blue text uses #6789EC.
Emphasis is one key word on a solid blue block, at most once per slide.
Labels and metadata are JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked out.
Buttons are square (4px radius), solid brand blue, Manrope SemiBold, sentence case.
Footer on every slide: BUILDABLELABS.COM bottom-left in plain text (not a logo), swipe cue bottom-right; the last slide may carry a CTA cue instead.

House rules for Instagram: no slide or page numbers, no kicker or eyebrow above the headline, no text under 34px, 6 slides maximum, a real visual on every slide (slide 1 an infographic), no self-promotion.
Patterns (Loop, Weave, Ascent) sit at 5-12% opacity in the background only.
Imagery: never stock photography, AI-hype gradients, neon glow, busy photographic backgrounds or generic tech imagery.
Numbers on slides must come from a source in the brief, with a source line.
No logo or brand mark on posts; the handle is the only brand sign-off.
